title: Revealing the Properties of Dark Matter in the Merging Cluster MACS J0025.4-1222

evidence.locator: Sect. III: the peak of the adaptively smoothed X-ray image is at 00:25:29.5, -12:22:36.6, within 5 arcsec. Table 2: offsets of the peaks from it in arcminutes; total mass, south-east (-0.70 +/- 0.25, -0.43 +/- 0.06) and north-west (0.46 +/- 0.13, 0.20 +/- 0.04); Figures 3 and 4 have north up and east left. Sect. V: the subclusters differ by 100 +/- 80 km/s along the line of sight. Abstract: the total mass of each subcluster is offset from the peak of the hot gas and aligned with the galaxies; a head-on collision in the plane of the sky is assumed.
